labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Feature request for a generic SpeedColumn with a custom unit; upstream requires Discussions approval first.

body:
Please start a discussion in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) for a generic speed column with a custom unit. New features need approval there before an issue is opened.

Rich already has some of this. `TaskProgressColumn` shows speed when `total` is unknown (`show_speed`), and [`TransferSpeedColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) covers byte rates. A column for other units can be written by subclassing `ProgressColumn`. For a related request on `TaskProgressColumn`, see #3835.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
